provenance.construction: Generalized bicycle over the metacyclic realisation of Aff(F_19): G = Z_19 x| Z_18 with a primitive root acting, block size n = 2*q*(q-1) = 684. Monomials a = [231, 266, 341, 251, 274, 84] and b = [112, 210, 250, 135, 327, 100] over F_2[G], each of weight 6, so check weight 12. Drawn by sample_kasai_affine (research/kit/search.py) at seed 7 and screened at 50 RIS trials reading 131; refine at 2000 trials read 125; the packaging witness search gave d = 124 on both the X and the Z side, and the gate refutation found no lighter logical in 8000 RIS trials at a fresh seed. Distances are witness-backed upper bounds under that search, not certificates. A deeper accelerated search (verify/gate_changed.py, ~8M RIS trials) then found a weight-105 Z logical under the earlier 111 reading, and a second refutation found a weight-104 Z logical under that. Four independent 8M-trial gate runs have produced minima of 104, 105, 110 and 111 and never anything below 104, so the entry is filed at d = 104 with X 110 and Z 104 witnesses.
